description: Reopening a different file keeps the editor buffers and pending saves separate. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a directory holding first.md, which reads "# First file", and second.md, which reads "# Second file". Call "first.md" says whether first.md on disk contains "Pending edit" ("true" or "false"); call "second.md" returns second.md's contents on disk, JSON-encoded. To "open F": press "p" (lowercase) with the Control modifier (on whatever has focus); wait for the finder input ".grp-filter" to be visible; fill it with F; wait for the FIRST ".grp-row" to contain F (assert_text_contains on ".grp-row", which checks the first match: the finder lists every file until the query applies, and Enter opens the top row, so waiting for any row with the text is not enough); press Enter in the finder input; the dialog (role "dialog") whose accessible name matches the regular expression /Edit .*F/ is then "the modal" for F, and its ".monaco-editor" should become visible (up to 15s). "The preview" is the modal's region (role "region") named "Markdown preview". "The editor input" is the modal's ".monaco-editor textarea.inputarea"; to focus it, eval its focus(). Key presses go to whatever has focus; do not click anything to focus first unless a step says so. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Open first.md. 3. Focus the editor input. 4. Press "End" with the Control modifier. 5. Type, key by key, "\n## Pending edit" (the \n presses Enter). 6. Press "p" (lowercase) with the modifiers Control+Alt. 7. The modal should show a visible heading "Pending edit". 8. The finder stacks above the editor: press "p" (lowercase) with the Control modifier, wait for ".grp-filter" to be visible, fill it with "second.md", and wait for the first ".grp-row" to contain "second.md". 9. Press "p" (lowercase) with the modifiers Control+Alt (focus is in the finder). 10. The first.md modal's "Markdown preview" region should still be visible. 11. Press Enter in the finder input. Selecting a second file must unmount the first editor, flushing its pending save to the FIRST path. 12. In the dialog whose accessible name matches /Edit .*second\.md/ ("the second modal"), ".monaco-editor" should be visible. 13. The second modal must hold exactly 0 regions named "Markdown preview". 14. Click the second modal's button named "Preview mode". 15. The second modal should show a visible heading "Second file". 16. The second modal must not contain the text "Pending edit". 17. Call "first.md" until it returns "true". 18. Call "second.md": it must return exactly "\"# Second file\\n\"" (the file unchanged).
